text.tspan: AI4IA — request journey with the intent layer
Every prompt, every outcome. L0–L2 are new; L1 and L3 exist today.
video job · insight · compare / relay / mindmap
Rejected instantly — HTTP 422, no job created
specific message (greeting gets an example prompt)
harmful · abusive · illegal · sexual · re-role attempt
no subject · not about AI / the archive
slots checked against speaker registry + corpus:
speakers · topic · theme · chapter · years · title
Each intent = one module, VERSION recorded
panel speakers: mention windows, timeline spread,
larger pool; on-screen label = panel, never the person
top similarity vs floor (0.68) + topic words present
speaker+topic: checked on the speaker's own clips
topic_not_covered "The archive doesn't have talks on …"
Partial — render and narrate the gap
stated once, in general terms; never quotes the prompt
writes prompt_resolutions — one row per request, updated by each layer (intent, VERSION, slots, outcome, reason_code, message)
self-hosted model call — writes llm_call_traces + llm_call_payloads (exact request and response text)
Cancel (DELETE /api/video-jobs/{id}) at any point after queueing → status cancelled. Red = rejected · Amber = declined (not in archive) · Blue = partial · Green = completed
